about: Every flag reason the pipeline can put on a question, and the lane that settles it. Written for the website (student checker and admin queue) to read. Plain English, no dashes. Counts are a snapshot of open kid and admin questions; python -m pipeline.lanes --census rewrites them.
rule: A student only checks a question with a page picture in front of them: a crop around the question first, a tap to see the whole page. No picture: the question goes to an admin with a plain reason. Every move is written to the review log.

owners.student_with_picture: A student settles it, looking at the page picture. Without a picture it goes to an admin instead.
owners.admin: An admin settles it. A student is never asked.
owners.ai_then_admin: The AI settles it on its own; whatever it cannot settle waits for an admin. A student is never asked.

read_words.name: Read the words against the page
read_words.what_to_do: Compare the question with the printed page. Fix any word, number or symbol that differs. If the page itself has a mistake, say so, do not correct it.

joined_or_split.name: Joined or split questions
joined_or_split.what_to_do: Two questions may be stuck together, or one question may be cut in two. Split or join them so each question stands on its own.

page_clutter.name: Page clutter in the question
page_clutter.what_to_do: Remove text that belongs to the page, such as a page number or a header, and leave only the question.

options.name: Answer options
options.what_to_do: Check that every option is there, in order, and matches the page.

marks.name: Marks
marks.what_to_do: Check the marks against the page. If the page prints no marks for this question, leave the marks empty.

number.name: Question number
number.what_to_do: Fill in the number printed beside the question. If none is printed, leave it empty.

figure.name: Picture or diagram not attached
figure.what_to_do: The question mentions a picture or diagram that is not attached. Check that the words read right. The figure itself is attached separately.

empty_question.name: Question with no words yet
empty_question.what_to_do: The words were lost, for example because an answer was printed inside the question. The AI transcribes them from the page, then a student checks the result.

label.name: Label tidy-up
label.what_to_do: The chapter or kind of question is missing or unsure. The AI fills it from the paper; an admin settles what is left. Nothing is asked of a student.

find_on_page.name: Question not found on the page
find_on_page.what_to_do: The computer could not find this question on the page picture. An admin finds it, or sets the question aside.

duplicate.name: Possible duplicate
duplicate.what_to_do: This question may already be on the site. An admin compares the two and keeps one.

personal_data.name: Possible personal details
personal_data.what_to_do: The question may hold a real name, roll number or phone number. An admin checks and removes it.

board_class.name: Board or class may be wrong
board_class.what_to_do: The paper may be filed under the wrong board or class. An admin checks the paper's heading.

rescan.name: Needs a rescan
rescan.what_to_do: A page came back unreadable. The paper has to be scanned again, so no one can check it yet.

other_script.name: Needs a different reader
other_script.what_to_do: The page is in a script the reading software cannot handle. It needs a different reader.

english_release.name: English release check
english_release.what_to_do: English questions are checked by the AI first and never reach students. An admin sees only what the AI could not settle.
